`BufferManager` shall allow the specification of multiple bins of buffers based on the size of the buffer
Requirement.rationale: Allows for some optimization of memory usage if buffers of varying sizes are needed

Requirement.text: `BufferManager` shall allocate the first buffer larger than the requested size from the set of unallocated buffers, starting with the smallest set of buffers.
Requirement.rationale: If a buffer from a smaller pool is not available, allow using larger buffers to avoid starving the user

Requirement.text: `BufferManager` shall return an empty buffer (size = 0) if no buffers are available
Requirement.rationale: Allow the user to decide how to react to no memory

Requirement.text: `BufferManager` shall accept empty returned buffers without an assert
Requirement.rationale: Just send a warning to cover the case where an empty buffer is returned by a component

Requirement.text: `BufferManager` shall use a provided Fw::MemAllocator instance to request overall buffer memory
Requirement.rationale: Let the user decide where the memory comes from

Requirement.text: `BufferManager` shall allow buffers to be returned in any order
Requirement.rationale: Do not restrict the lifetime or usage of buffers

The buffer repeater shall copy the incoming data before each repeated send
The buffer repeater shall only send a copy to connected components
The buffer repeater shall have a configurable response to allocation failures

The `Svc::CmdDispatcher` component shall dispatch commands to components
The `Svc::CmdDispatcher` component shall provide an interface to register commands
The `Svc::CmdDispatcher` component shall process command status from components and report the results to the command buffer sender.
The `Svc::CmdSequencer` component shall read sequence files.
Requirement.rationale: CmdSequencer gets commands from the sequence file.

Requirement.text: The `Svc::CmdSequencer` component shall validate the sequence files with a CRC.
Requirement.rationale: CmdSequencer need to know it has a valid file.

Requirement.text: The `Svc::CmdSequencer` component shall provide a command to validate the sequence file.
Requirement.rationale: Waiting to validate the file only when running it can cause operational issues

Requirement.text: The `Svc::CmdSequencer` component shall cancel the sequence upon receiving a failed command status.
Requirement.rationale: A sequence should not continue if a command fails since subsequent commands may depend on the outcome

Requirement.text: The `Svc::CmdSequencer` component shall provide a command to cancel the existing sequence
Requirement.rationale: Operator should be able to cancel the sequence if it is hung or needs to be stopped.

Requirement.text: The `Svc::CmdSequencer` component shall provide an overall sequence timeout.
Requirement.rationale: Sequencer should quit if a component fails to send a command response

Requirement.text: The `Svc::CmdSplitter` component shall support multiple command sources.
The `Svc::CmdSplitter` component shall accept incoming command buffers.
The `Svc::CmdSplitter` component shall route commands under a configured value to the "local" port.
The `Svc::CmdSplitter` component shall route commands under a configured value to the "remote" port.
The `Svc::CmdSplitter` component shall route commands to the "local" port when an error occurs.
The `Svc::CmdSplitter` component shall forward command status responses.
`Svc::ComQueue` shall queue `Fw::Buffer` and `Fw::ComBuffer` received on incoming ports.
Requirement.rationale: The purpose of the queue is to store messages.

Requirement.text: `Svc::ComQueue` shall output exactly one `Fw::Buffer` or `Fw::ComBuffer` message on a received `Fw::Success::SUCCESS` signal.
Requirement.rationale: `Svc::ComQueue` obeys the communication adapter interface protocol.

Requirement.text: `Svc::ComQueue` shall pause sending  on the  `Fw::Success::FAILURE` and restart on the next `Fw::Success::SUCCESS` signal.
Requirement.rationale: `Svc::ComQueue` should not sent to a failing communication adapter.

Requirement.text: `Svc::ComQueue` shall have a configurable number of `Fw::Com` and `Fw::Buffer` input ports.
Requirement.rationale: `Svc::ComQueue` should be adaptable for a number of projects.

Requirement.text: `Svc::ComQueue` shall select and send the next priority `Fw::Buffer` and `Fw::ComBuffer` message in response to `Fw::Success::SUCCESS`.
Requirement.rationale: `Svc::ComQueue` obeys the communication adapter interface protocol.

Requirement.text: `Svc::ComQueue` shall periodically telemeter the number of queued messages per-port in response to a `run` port invocation.
Requirement.rationale: `Svc::ComQueue` should provide useful telemetry.

Requirement.text: `Svc::ComQueue` shall emit a queue overflow event for a given port when the configured depth is exceeded. Messages shall be discarded.
Requirement.rationale: `Svc::ComQueue` needs to indicate off-nominal events.

Requirement.text: `Svc::ComQueue` shall implement a round robin approach to balance between ports of the same priority.
Requirement.rationale: Allows projects to balance between a set of queues of similar priority.

Requirement.text: `Svc::ComQueue` shall keep track and throttle queue overflow events per port.
Requirement.rationale: Prevents a flood of queue overflow events.

Requirement.text: `Svc::ComStub` shall accept `Fw::Buffer` for transmission and  pass them to a `Drv::ByteStreamSend` port
Requirement.rationale: The comm interface must send `Fw::Buffer`s through a driver

Requirement.text: `Svc::ComStub` shall send a `Fw::Success:SUCCESS` signal via an `Fw.SuccessCondition` port on `Drv::ByteStreamSend` success
Requirement.rationale: Successful sends must notify any attached `Svc::ComQueue`

Requirement.text: `Svc::ComStub` shall send a `Fw::Success:FAILURE` signal via an `Fw.SuccessCondition` port on `Drv::ByteStreamSend` failure
Requirement.rationale: Failed sends must notify any attached `Svc::ComQueue`

Requirement.text: `Svc::ComStub` shall retry sending to `Drv::ByteStreamSend` on `Drv::ByteStreamSend` retry
Requirement.rationale: Sends indicating `RETRY` should be retried.

Requirement.text: `Svc::ComStub` shall pass-through `Fw::Buffer` from a  `Drv::ByteStreamRead` on `Drv::ByteStreamSend` success
Requirement.rationale: A Comm interface must receive `Fw::Buffer`s from a driver

Requirement.text: `Svc::Deframer` shall accept a sequence of byte buffers and interpret their concatenated data as a sequence of uplink frames.
Requirement.rationale: The purpose of the component is to do uplink deframing.

Requirement.text: `Svc::Deframer` shall accept byte buffers containing uplink frames that are not aligned on a buffer boundary.
Requirement.rationale: For flexibility, we do not require that the frames be aligned on a buffer boundary.

Requirement.text: `Svc::Deframer` shall accept byte buffers containing uplink frames that span one or more buffers.
Requirement.rationale: For flexibility, we do not require each frame to fit in a single buffer.

Requirement.text: `Svc::Deframer` shall provide a port interface that a threaded driver can use to push byte buffers to be deframed.
Requirement.rationale: This interface supports applications in which the byte stream driver has its own thread.

Requirement.text: `Svc::Deframer` shall provide a port interface that Deframer can use to poll for byte buffers to be deframed.
Requirement.rationale: This interface supports applications in which byte stream driver does not have its own thread.

Requirement.text: If the polling interface is connected, then `Svc::Deframer` shall poll for byte buffers on its `schedIn` port.
Requirement.rationale: This requirement allows the system scheduler to drive the periodic polling.

Requirement.text: `Svc::Deframer` shall use an instance of `Svc::DeframingProtocol`, supplied when the component is instantiated, to validate the frames and extract their packet data.
Requirement.rationale: Using the `Svc::DeframingProtocol` interface allows the same Deframer component to operate with different protocols.

Requirement.text: `Svc::Deframer` shall interpret the initial bytes of the packet data as a value of type `FwPacketDescriptorType`.
Requirement.rationale: `FwPacketDescriptorType` is the type of an F Prime packet descriptor. The size of the type is configurable in the F Prime framework.

Requirement.text: `Svc::Deframer` shall extract and send packets with the following types: `Fw::ComPacket::FW_PACKET_COMMAND`, `Fw::ComPacket::FW_PACKET_FILE`.
Requirement.rationale: These are the packet types used for uplink.

Requirement.text: `Svc::Deframer` shall send command packets and file packets on separate ports.
Requirement.rationale: Command packets and file packets are typically handled by different components.

Requirement.text: `Svc::Deframer` shall operate nominally when its port for sending file packets is unconnected, even if it receives a frame containing a file packet.
Requirement.rationale: Some applications do not use file uplink. Sending a file uplink packet to `Deframer` should not crash the application because of an unconnected port.

`FileDownlink` shall queue up a list of files to downlink
Requirement.rationale: The requirement provides the ability to simultaneously queue up multiple files for downlink from different sources

Requirement.text: `FileDownlink` shall read a file from non-volatile storage, partition the file into packets, and send out the packets.
Requirement.rationale: This requirement provides the capability to downlink files from the spacecraft.

Requirement.text: `FileDownlink` shall wait for a cooldown after completing a file downlink before starting another file downlink
Requirement.rationale: Allows a saturated link to process a backlog that may have built up during a file downlink

Requirement.text: `FileUplink` shall receive file packets, assemble them into files, and store the files in the on-board non-volatile storage.
Requirement.rationale: This requirement provides the capability to uplink files to the spacecraft.

Requirement.text: `Svc::Framer` shall accept data packets of any type stored in `Fw::Com` buffers.
Requirement.rationale: `Svc::ActiveLogger` and `Svc::ChanTlm` emit packets as `Fw::Com` buffers.

Requirement.text: `Svc::Framer` shall accept file packets stored in `Fw::Buffer` objects.
Requirement.rationale: `Svc::FileDownlink` emits packets as `Fw::Buffer` objects.

Requirement.text: `Svc::Framer` shall use an instance of `Svc::FramingProtocol`, supplied when the component is instantiated, to wrap packets in frames.
Requirement.rationale: The purpose of `Svc::Framer` is to frame data packets. Using the `Svc::FramingProtocol` interface allows the same Framer component to operate with different protocols.

Requirement.text: `Svc::Framer` shall emit a status of `Fw::Success::SUCCESS`  when no framed packets were sent in response to incoming buffer.
Requirement.rationale: `Svc::Framer` implements the framer status protocol.

Requirement.text: `Svc::Framer` shall forward `Fw::Success` status messages received
Requirement.rationale: `Svc::Framer` implements the framer status protocol.
